PreviousReference.name: Previous Reference
PreviousReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously sent.

OtherReference.name: Other Reference
OtherReference.definition: Reference to a linked message sent in a proprietary way or reference of a system.

PreviousReferenceGuideline.definition: If PreviousReference/MessageName is present, it must start with acmt.001 or acmt.003 and PreviousReference/Reference must contain the business reference of a message.

OtherReferenceGuideline.definition: OtherReference should be used for an account opening or an account modification instruction sent in a proprietary way or for system references. |If OtherReference is present, OtherReference/MessageName must contain, for example, 'fax' or 'phone' or 'email'.
